xwikidoc.title: Advanced Bookmarks JSON service
xwikidoc.content: {{velocity}} ## --------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## JSON service of Advanced Bookmarks, called by the star and the management ## page with the "get" action: <service URL>?operation=... ## isBookmarked page=<reference> ## toggle page=<reference> (POST, form_token) ## getBookmarks [user=<reference>] ## save [user=<reference>], data=<JSON>, version (POST, form_token) ## Rights, POST and CSRF checks are made by $services.advancedbookmarks: this ## page only dispatches the operation and sets the HTTP status. ## --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #if ($xcontext.action == 'get') #set ($operation = "$!request.operation") #if (!$services.advancedbookmarks) #set ($result = {'status': 503, 'error': 'unavailable'}) #elseif ($operation == 'isBookmarked') #set ($result = $services.advancedbookmarks.isBookmarked("$!request.page")) #elseif ($operation == 'toggle') #set ($result = $services.advancedbookmarks.toggle("$!request.page")) #elseif ($operation == 'getBookmarks') #set ($result = $services.advancedbookmarks.getBookmarks("$!request.user")) #elseif ($operation == 'save') #set ($version = $numbertool.toNumber("$!request.version")) #if ("$!version" == '') #set ($result = {'status': 400, 'error': 'invalid'}) #else #set ($result = $services.advancedbookmarks.save("$!request.user", "$!request.data", $version.longValue())) #end #else #set ($result = {'status': 400, 'error': 'unknownOperation'}) #end #set ($discard = $response.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store')) #set ($discard = $response.setStatus($result.status)) #jsonResponse($result) #end {{/velocity}}
